description: Search Expedia hotels by destination or by hotel/search URL and return live rates, exact star class, guest ratings, review counts, address, amenities, and optional room rates with cancellation policies.

amenities.description: Only hotels with all selected amenities. Leave empty for no amenity filter.
amenities.title: Amenities

availableOnly.description: Only return properties with rooms available for the selected dates.
availableOnly.title: Available only

checkIn.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use 30 days from today.
checkIn.title: Check-in date

checkOut.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use 2 nights after check-in.
checkOut.title: Check-out date

childrenAges.description: One age (0-17) per child. Leave empty for no children.
childrenAges.title: Children ages

destination.description: City, area, landmark, airport, or hotel name to search (mode=search). Examples: New York, London, Tokyo, Times Square.
destination.title: Destination

destinationId.description: Optional Expedia region ID to skip destination lookup (mode=search). Use only if you already know the region ID.
destinationId.title: Destination ID

freeCancellationOnly.description: Only return properties with a fully refundable rate.
freeCancellationOnly.title: Free cancellation only

includePropertyDetails.description: Add exact star class, address, coordinates, full amenities, policies, and gallery images. This fetches one property page per hotel (mode=search).
includePropertyDetails.title: Include property details

includeRoomRates.description: Add room types, live nightly rates, payment policy, and cancellation policy for each hotel. This makes one extra request per hotel.
includeRoomRates.title: Include room rates

maxItems.description: Hard cap on hotel records (1-1000). Expedia returns up to 500 per request; larger caps use nextSubSet pagination.
maxItems.title: Maximum hotels

maxPrice.description: Maximum nightly price in USD. Hotels without a nightly price are skipped when a price limit is set.
maxPrice.title: Maximum nightly price

minGuestRating.description: Minimum guest review score on Expedia's 10-point scale.
minGuestRating.title: Minimum guest rating

minPrice.description: Minimum nightly price in USD. Hotels without a nightly price are skipped when a price limit is set.
minPrice.title: Minimum nightly price

mode.description: Search by destination, or scrape Expedia hotel and search URLs/IDs.
mode.title: Mode

propertyName.description: Filter by property name, for example Marriott or Hilton.
propertyName.title: Property name

propertyType.description: Restrict results to a type of place.
propertyType.title: Property type

sortBy.description: Order of the hotel search results.
sortBy.title: Sort by

starRatings.description: Only these star classes (1-5). Leave empty for all stars.
starRatings.title: Star ratings

startUrls.description: Expedia hotel pages, Hotel-Search links, share links, or bare hotel IDs such as h17117062 or 17117062 (mode=urls).
startUrls.title: Hotel or search URLs

title: Expedia Hotel Rate & Guest Rating Finder Input
